notes.title: First update is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi all. 

I know it has been very quiet, but today we are happy to announce the first update to Polydome! 

There are now 2 modules: Gems and Wavecraft.
Gems: 
- You can now choose the gem type that you want to create by tapping the touchbutton left or right.
- You can now create multiple patterns side by side.
- You can change the gems in a pattern by "holding" it and tap the touchbutton left or right.

Wavecraft: 
- A new module where you create sculptures / buildings with your voice.
- Aim at the floor, where you want to create the building, pull the trigger and hold while talking/singing or what ever and a sculpture will form.
- You can scrub the recording by pointing on the sculpture. 
- By pulling the trigger while pointing on the building you will toggle loopmode.
- Teleport around by pressing the touch button.

Have fun!

Best

Plan8
